features.title: Send when the attachment upload finishes
features.summary: Enter, or a press on the disabled Send button, while a file attachment is still uploading queues the send behind a 'Sending when upload finishes…' banner with Cancel. Editing the text or the attachments, Escape or Cancel drops it; it sends on its own once every upload is ready.
failureModes: A failed upload, or one still running after five minutes, leaves the message unsent with a notice instead of sending without the file.
A deferred send queues behind a running turn; it never steers.

verification.testName: cancels when the text or the attachments change, and a later upload does not send
reports a failed upload instead of sending, and can be dismissed
